title: PROMOTION TERMS & CONDITIONS
officialText:
LIMITED TIME OFFER
Prices shown reflect the Limited Time Offer price.
Limited quantity - pricing available while supply lasts.
Limited Time Offer pricing is only available on select colors, styles, and sizes, marked as "Sale".
Limited Time Offer pricing can be combined with sitewide sale.
Limited Time Offer pricing cannot be combined with a new-subscriber coupon code.
Discount does not apply to tax or shipping fees.
CLEARANCE
Prices shown reflect the Clearance price.
Limited quantity - pricing available while supply lasts.
Pricing is only available on select colors, styles, and sizes, marked as "Clearance".
Clearance and final sale items cannot be returned or exchanged.
Clearance pricing cannot be combined with other offers.
Discount does not apply to tax or shipping fees.
NEW-SUBSCRIBER EXCLUSIVE COUPON
The coupon is only available at regular prices for applicable items.
The coupon is valid within 15 days from the date of subscription.
Enter the coupon code into the coupon code box on the CART SUMMARY or ORDER SUMMARY to redeem the discount.
The coupon cannot be stacked with limited time offers, clearance offers or sitewide sale.
The coupon is for the user's personal use only, and it can only be used once per user and for one order.
Discount does not apply to tax or shipping fees.
The coupon cannot be exchanged for cash and no refund or change will be given.
PROMOTIONAL CODES
Promotional Codes are only applicable to the cost of products and are not applicable on shipping fees.
Promotional codes are valid for customers of www.cozeware.com.
Promotional codes cannot be combined with other promotions or promotional codes unless stated.
COZEWARE reserves the right to verify the validity of the promotional discount code and may at its sole discretion cancel orders or refuse to fulfl orders where the discount code has been used by a non-qualfying member.
Your purchase and delivery are subject to COZEWARE's standard Terms & Conditions.
Additional conditions of use may apply and will be communicated by COZEWARE.
